description_en: Attaches server groups to a scaling group. To seamlessly adjust the number of instances in response to changes in your business workload or to maintain the uninterrupted accessibility of your application, you can call the AttachServerGroups operation. By attaching Application Load Balancer (ALB), Network Load Balancer (NLB), or Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) server groups to your scaling group, this operation enables Auto Scaling to automatically tailor your computing capacity to your business needs. Furthermore, it optimizes traffic routing by dynamically allocating incoming requests based on current workload patterns, which significantly improves the stability and performance of your application
description_zh: 对于需要动态调整实例数量来应对业务变化负载以及确保应用程序的高可用性场景，调用API AttachServerGroups为伸缩组添加一个或多个负载均衡服务器组，支持的服务器组类型包括应用型负载均衡ALB、网络型负载均衡NLB和网关型负载均衡GWLB，可以在业务变化时自动实现弹性扩展，并根据负载情况动态分配流量、提高应用程序的稳定性
kebab_example: aliyun ess attach-server-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp1fo0dbtsbmqa9h0000 --server-groups Type=ALB Port=22 ServerGroupId=sgp-5yc3bd9lfyh00000 Weight=100 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachServerGroups

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add the existing Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances or elastic container instances (ECI) in the scaling group to the server group. Valid values:

true
false

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否将当前伸缩组内的ECS实例或ECI实例添加到新增的服务器组。取值范围：

true：添加。

false：不添加。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_attach

fields.help_en:
The port used by ECS or ECI instances after being added as backend servers to the server group.

Valid values: 1 to 65535.

For ALB and NLB types, this parameter is required. GWLB type cannot set this parameter and the default value is 6081
fields.help_zh:
弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到服务器组后，ECS实例或ECI实例使用的端口号。

取值范围：1~65535。
ALB和NLB类型负载均衡该参数为必填参数，GWLB类型负载均衡不能设置该参数且默认值为6081
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The ID of the server group
fields.name: server_group_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the server group. Valid Values:

ALB
NLB
GWLB
fields.help_zh:
负载均衡服务器组类型。取值范围：

ALB：应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。
NLB：网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer）。
GWLB：网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The weight of an ECS or ECI instance as a backend server of the server group. Valid values: 0 to 100

If you assign a higher weight to an instance, the instance is allocated a larger proportion of access requests. If the weight is 0, the ECS or ECI instance does not receive access requests.

For ALB and NLB types, this parameter is required. GWLB type cannot be set
fields.help_zh:
弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到服务器组后，ECS实例或ECI实例作为后端服务器的权重。取值范围：0~100。

权重越高，ECS实例或ECI实例将被分配到越多的访问请求。如果权重为0，则ECS实例或ECI实例不会收到访问请求。

ALB和NLB类型负载均衡该参数为必填参数，GWLB类型负载均衡不能设置该参数
fields.name: weight

ScalingActivityId.description_en:
The ID of the scaling activity. During the scaling activity, the server group is attached to the scaling group and the existing ECS instances or elastic container instances in the scaling group are added to the server group.

This parameter is returned only if you set ForceAttach to true
ScalingActivityId.description_zh:
添加负载均衡服务器组并将伸缩组内的ECS实例或ECI实例添加到该服务器组时，伸缩活动的ID。
仅当ForceAttach取值为true时，返回该参数
